meta.title: Essaouira Coastal Day Trip | Shared Morocco Adventures
meta.description: A full-day shared trip from Marrakech to Essaouira — UNESCO-listed medina, sea ramparts and the Atlantic fishing port. From €51pp.
meta.ogDescription: A shared day trip from Marrakech to the Atlantic port town of Essaouira. From €51pp.

hero.lead: Marrakech → Argan Forest → Essaouira Medina & Port → Marrakech

overview.h2: Trade the medina heat for sea air
paras: Trade the medina heat for sea air in Marrakech's favorite coastal escape — a laid-back, UNESCO-listed fishing town with whitewashed ramparts and a noticeably cooler Atlantic breeze, roughly 2.5–3 hours each way.

A guided walk covers the medina's ramparts (the Skala), art galleries, and woodworking workshops, followed by free time at the fishing port for lunch (fresh grilled seafood is the local specialty) and shopping.
chips: 🚗 ≈360 km round trip · about 5.5 hrs driving

paras: Essaouira's Atlantic breeze is noticeably cooler than Marrakech year-round — a light jacket or scarf makes the ramparts walk more comfortable.
Booking terms: Send an enquiry first; we confirm the departure time, final price, and pickup details by email. No payment is taken through this website.

items.a: Yes — with roughly 5.5 hours of driving round trip, it's one of our longer trips. You'll still get several hours of free time in Essaouira itself.

items.q: What's the best food to try there?
items.a: Freshly grilled seafood straight from the fishing port stalls is the local specialty — pick your catch and it's grilled to order.

items.q: Can I stay overnight instead of returning the same day?
items.a: This route is a shared day trip, but our 8-Day Desert & Atlantic Coast Tour includes two full nights in Essaouira if you'd like more time there.
